title: A Stochastic Maximum Principle for Partially Observed Jump-Diffusion Systems with State-Dependent Counting-Process Observations
summary: This paper studies a partially observed stochastic optimal control problem for jump-diffusion states observed through multivariate counting processes with state-dependent intensities. Because the observation jumps carry information about the latent state through their intensities, the variational analysis involves coupled state and likelihood-ratio perturbations.
